# `@videojs/spf/behaviors/resolve-track`

Source: [src/playback/behaviors/resolve-track.ts](../../../src/playback/behaviors/resolve-track.ts)

## resolveAudioTrack

Resolve unresolved audio tracks. Same shape as `resolveVideoTrack`, narrowed to audio.

Source: [src/playback/behaviors/resolve-track.ts](../../../src/playback/behaviors/resolve-track.ts)

### Config

The setup declares `config?`: callers may omit it.

| Key | Type | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gateFirstParse?` | `GateFirstParse` | First-parse placement gate (see `primitives/gate-first-parse`); absent → parse immediately. |
| `getCdnId?` | `GetCdnId` | CDN-id derivation for the failover trip; defaults to origin-based `getCdnId`. See `TrackSwitchingSharedConfig['getCdnId']`. |
| `reportUnsupportedTrackConditions?` | `ReportUnsupportedTrackConditions` | Playlist-derived condition reporting (see `primitives/report-track-conditions`). |
| `requestCredentials?` | `RequestCredentialsPolicy` | The `credentials` mode media-playlist requests are made with; absent → the platform default. |
| `reschedule?` | `Reschedule<ResolvedTrack>` | Live media-playlist re-run policy; absent → resolve once. |
| `resolveKeyUri?` | `ResolveKeyUri` | `EXT-X-KEY` URI handling; absent → `parseMediaPlaylist`'s default. |

### State

| Key | Access | Declared | Type | Owner | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `presentation` | writes | yes | `MaybeResolvedPresentation \| undefined` | `ResolveTrackState` | The presentation being played. A caller writes `{ url }`; `resolvePresentation` parses the manifest and populates the rest. (doc of [resolvePresentation](resolve-presentation.md#resolvepresentation)) |
| `selectedAudioTrackId` | reads | yes | `string \| undefined` | `ResolveTrackState` | The id of the audio track in play: `switchAudioTrack`'s pick, on the same terms as `selectedVideoTrackId`. `resolveAudioTrack`, `setupAudioBufferActors`, and `loadAudioSegments` key their work on it. (doc of [switchAudioTrack](track-switching.md#switchaudiotrack)) |

## resolveVideoTrack

Resolve unresolved video tracks. Schedules a fetch task whenever the selected video track is partially resolved,
parses the manifest, and writes the resolved track back into `state.presentation`.

Source: [src/playback/behaviors/resolve-track.ts](../../../src/playback/behaviors/resolve-track.ts)

### Config

The setup declares `config?`: callers may omit it.

| Key | Type | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gateFirstParse?` | `GateFirstParse` | First-parse placement gate (see `primitives/gate-first-parse`); absent → parse immediately. |
| `getCdnId?` | `GetCdnId` | CDN-id derivation for the failover trip; defaults to origin-based `getCdnId`. See `TrackSwitchingSharedConfig['getCdnId']`. |
| `reportUnsupportedTrackConditions?` | `ReportUnsupportedTrackConditions` | Playlist-derived condition reporting (see `primitives/report-track-conditions`). |
| `requestCredentials?` | `RequestCredentialsPolicy` | The `credentials` mode media-playlist requests are made with; absent → the platform default. |
| `reschedule?` | `Reschedule<ResolvedTrack>` | Live media-playlist re-run policy; absent → resolve once. |
| `resolveKeyUri?` | `ResolveKeyUri` | `EXT-X-KEY` URI handling; absent → `parseMediaPlaylist`'s default. |

### State

| Key | Access | Declared | Type | Owner | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `presentation` | writes | yes | `MaybeResolvedPresentation \| undefined` | `ResolveTrackState` | The presentation being played. A caller writes `{ url }`; `resolvePresentation` parses the manifest and populates the rest. (doc of [resolvePresentation](resolve-presentation.md#resolvepresentation)) |
| `selectedVideoTrackId` | reads | yes | `string \| undefined` | `ResolveTrackState` | The id of the video track in play: `switchVideoTrack`'s pick, written when `presentation` resolves and re-picked whenever a rule input changes; cleared when the resolved presentation goes away or no candidate survives the constraints. `resolveVideoTrack`, `setupVideoBufferActors`, and `loadVideoSegments` key their work on it.
